text: A hedgehog’s spines are modified hairs, made mostly of keratin—the same material as human fingernails. They’re replaced gradually, rather than all at once.
Repair cafés show how local know-how can keep household items in use: volunteers help people mend belongings, sharing skills as well as tools.
At your local library, check the noticeboard for a free event or shared resource you hadn’t noticed before; tell someone nearby what’s available.
